messages:
alex: Quick heads-up: deploybot scheduled a tf apply for module infra-network (v2.9.0 -> v2.10.0) in tonight's quiet change window 01:30 UTC. Please review pin and rollback steps. @riley @devops

riley: What changed? IAM, routes, or just SGs?

devops: Mostly SG loosen + nat count bump 1->2. There's a CIDR shift in a private route too. CI pulled provider 4.71 but I'd prefer to avoid bumping provider in the window.

alex: Agreed. Plan: pin provider to 4.70 on the release branch and apply module-only. We'll run a dry-run plan in prod-preview and paste diffs here.

sam: I'll lead the apply and watch route telemetry. Ops: paste the staging plan snippet.

sree: staging plan excerpt:
```
# terraform plan
+ aws_nat_gateway.main (count: 1 -> 2)
~ aws_route.private (destination_cidr_block: 10.12.5.0/24 -> 10.12.6.0/24)
~ aws_security_group.app (ingress add tcp/443)
```
Note: route change looks non-destructive but verify there are no dependent route-table attachments.

deploybot: deploybot: apply queued by @alex for 2026-04-05T01:30:00Z. Apply id: 91234. Abort: `deploybot cancel 91234` up to 15m prior. Will run `terraform apply --auto-approve --var-file=release.tfvars`.

riley: Rollback sketch: 1) revert module to v2.9.0 on release branch 2) run `terraform apply --target=module.infra-network --var-file=rollback.tfvars` 3) if route issues, follow runbook: https://wiki.redwood/internal/runbooks/network-route-restore 4) if state mismatch, use state-restore runbook and contact SRE pager. I'll add to release notes.

sam: I'll be on call from 01:10 UTC and will stream plan output. If we see destructive route ops or >3m internal packet loss, I will pause deploybot and execute rollback steps.

alex: Commit pushed pinning provider to 4.70 and updated release notes under "infra: pin provider during change window". Branch `release/2026-04-05/net-pin`. Deploybot id 91234. Please ack.

sam: acked. Watching.

deploybot: deploybot: apply started (id:91234) at 2026-04-05T01:30:00Z. Streaming plan to this thread.

alex: thanks everyone. escalate to SRE if traffic drops.
